It expands the delete card inline: an Alert with intent="warning" plus a text Input, rendered inside the same Surface. destructive-not-default: The final confirm button is variant="destructive" and is visually distinct from the secondary Cancel button. It is disabled until the phrase matches and is not autofocused. Pressing Enter in the input will submit once the phrase matches. The rubric's requirement that the destructive action not be the visually primary action is therefore not clearly met.
